Target: NVIDIA (NVDA). NVIDIA designs accelerated computing platforms, GPUs and related software used in data centers, AI, graphics and gaming.

Focal announcement: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2024.

Decision cutoff: 2023-08-23T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2024. Published: 2023-08-23. URL: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2024.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: Record revenue of $13.51 billion, up 88% from Q1, up 101% from year ago NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the second quarter ended July 30, 2023, of $13.51 billion, up 101% from a year ago and up 88% from the previous quarter. During the second quarter of fiscal 2024, NVIDIA returned $3.38 billion to shareholders in the form of 7.5 million shares repurchased for $3.28 billion, and cash dividends. As of the end of the second quarter, the company had $3.95 billion remaining under its share repurchase authorization. Second-quarter revenue was a record $10.32 billion, up 141% from the previous quarter and up 171% from a year ago.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was only slightly favored. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is much narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.
